task_prompt:
You are an expert in robot kinematics and URDF-to-Ontology abstraction.
 
Task: Identify the single "Attachment Root" link for the body_part components provided in the input data.

Input Data Layout:
Each item in the input data represents a targeted component accompanied by its full kinematic chain sequence, ordered sequentially from the robot's primary root link (index 0) down to the functional leaf link (last index).

Definition:
The Attachment Root is the physical mounting interface working as a structural boundary between the associated body_part component assembly and the main structural morphology of the robot.

Strict Boundary Elimination Rules:
1. The Proximal Anchor: Identify the highest-level structural link at the base of the chain connecting the limb to the core component, that does not belong to that limb.
2. The Divergence Hub: In symmetric limbs, locate the common structural frame where those two tracks split apart.
3. The "Unscrew" Test: If you physically unbolted or detached this entire functional body_part assembly from the robot, which structural link remains intact on the main body? That link is your Attachment Root.
4. The Assembly Housing Exclusion: The Attachment Root MUST NOT be an internal sub-frame that is functionally part of the component assembly itself, or the last link before the core robot structure still belonging to that body_part component. 
5. Traversal Direction & Chassis Edge-Case: Do not fall into lexical naming traps. Trace leftward (towards index 0) until you exit the component's internal tree.

Input Data Format:

Kinematic Chain Input Format:
Th kinematic chain is an ordered list of contiguous elements provided using this array structure:
[["parent_link", "joint_name", "joint_type", "child_link"], ...].


Output Format:
Respond strictly in JSON following this structure: 
{
    "mounting_links": {
        "target_id": {
            "attachment_root": "string",
            "justification": "string"
            }
        }
}

For each justification attribute, provide a single, self-sufficient, clear sentence explaining the reason for your choice.
Do not include any extra text or markdown formatting.
